mentions.name: Family meal planning web app
mentions.description: A simple web app for family meal planning. The author's family has used it for a few months, and it is now being tidied up so others can use it too.
mentions.audience: Family meal planning was a chore the author wanted to make easier.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a very basic web app to make our family meal planning a bit easier.

We’ve been using it for a few months, so now I’m trying to tidy it up so others can use it too.

https://mealplannertool.com/
mentions.author: sensecall
